name: read
description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

prompt: Use the read tool — not shell commands like cat — to inspect text files. Use offset and limit to continue reading large files.
